+def mock_retry_state(attempt_number=1):

+wait_strat2 = tenacity.wait_fixed(5)
+combined_wait = tenacity.wait_combine(wait_strat1, wait_strat2)
+
+state = mock_retry_state()
+wait_time = combined_wait(state)
+print(f"Wait time: {wait_time}")
+# Expected: between 5.0 and 8.0
+# Actual: between 10.0 and 16.0

+# Test + operator
+combined_wait_plus = wait_strat1 + wait_strat2
+wait_time_plus = combined_wait_plus(state)
+print(f"Wait time plus: {wait_time_plus}")

+# Actual: between 10.0 and 16.0
